_how_to_use: To give a staff member a 'Read bio' button, add a line below with their name exactly as it appears on the Band Staff cards, then their bio as a list of paragraphs. People who are not listed here simply have no button. Delete this _how_to_use line if you like.
_example: This line is an example and is never shown. Copy the layout: name in quotes, a colon, then the paragraphs in square brackets, each in quotes and separated by commas.
Brandon Schumacher: Brandon Schumacher has been a dedicated music educator in Cheyenne, Wyoming, since 2008. He serves as the band director at Johnson Junior High School and assistant band director at South High School, where he has been part of the music program since the school's opening in 2010. A percussionist by training, Mr. Schumacher is passionate about helping students develop strong musical foundations, build confidence, and experience the rewards of teamwork and musical excellence.

Beyond the classroom, Mr. Schumacher is actively involved in supporting music education throughout Wyoming. He currently serves as the Southeast District President of the Wyoming Music Educators Association (WMEA) and has previously served as WMEA's Marching Band Chair and President of the Wyoming Chapter of the Percussive Arts Society.

His dedication to music education has earned recognition at both the state and national levels. In 2018, he was named one of School Band & Orchestra Magazine's annual "50 Directors Who Make a Difference." More recently, he was honored as the Wyoming Phi Beta Mu Band Director of the Year.

Mr. Schumacher takes great pride in being part of the South High School Band program and helping students grow not only as musicians but also as leaders and individuals. He believes that the lessons learned through music, including discipline, perseverance, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence, extend far beyond the rehearsal room.
Outside of school, Mr. Schumacher enjoys spending time with his wife and two children, who keep life busy, fun, and full of adventure.
Nick Simons: Nick Simons performs on flute, piccolo, euphonium and trombone in symphonies, wind ensembles, brass bands, pit orchestras, jazz bands and jazz combos, and has been a back-up performer for a variety of internationally and nationally known artists.

Nick retired in 2017 after 45 years as an instrumental music educator at the elementary, junior high and high school levels. He now substitutes and helps instruct and conduct high school bands, and has previously conducted college ensembles, community bands and professional-level programs.

He established a jazz combo, “Jazztet,” that has performed regularly in the Cheyenne area. Nick also established and regularly performs with the Cheyenne Brass Band, which performs at Laramie County Community College. He is also a band guest clinician, conductor and adjudicator in Wyoming.
